<div class="block"><p>Gets colors used for visualization of traffic conditions on route.</div>
<dl class="notes">
<dt>Returns:</dt>
<dd><p>Colors used to visualize traffic conditions on the route ahead of the current location, for segments with a jam factor of 4.0 or higher.
     For route segments with a jam factor below 4.0 and those behind the current location, <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-routeprogresscolors" title="class in com.here.sdk.navigation"><code>RouteProgressColors</code></a> are used instead.</dd>
</dl>
</section>
